title: Payer
description: The party funding a payment instrument. The payer MAY differ from the checkout's buyer, for example when a third party pays for someone else's order or a business pays for an individual's order. When omitted, the payer is the buyer.

identification.title: Payer Identification
identification.description: Legal or tax identification of the payer (taxpayer document), required by some payment methods and jurisdictions, such as Pix and boleto in Brazil. This is sensitive personal data: a platform SHOULD send it only when the selected handler or jurisdiction requires it, and it MUST NOT be used as an authentication credential.

type.description: Document type as an open, lowercase token: the ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, a dot, and the document name. Open so a new jurisdiction needs no spec change. Non-exhaustive registry: br.cpf, br.cnpj, mx.rfc, ar.cuit, ar.cuil, cl.rut, uy.ci, co.nit, pe.ruc.

number.description: The document value as issued. Platforms SHOULD send the issuer's canonical form. Core applies no per-jurisdiction format or check-digit validation; the business or payment handler validates and MAY normalize common variants.
